handover_report.prepared_for: Next AI engineering agent / continuation session

repository.name: everythingAI
repository.working_branch_policy: All work happens directly on main unless the user explicitly changes this rule.

executive_summary.project_identity: EverythingAI is a local-first, source-backed AI knowledge workspace and file intelligence platform. It indexes scoped local files, extracts content, builds durable knowledge/wiki views, generates governed planning suggestions, supports safe file organization, and separates normal Client Workspace usage from Admin Dashboard operations.
executive_summary.current_state: The Local MVP is technically validated, smoke-tested in the running Windows environment, and now includes admin-only Agent Connectors plus client chat provider hardening. Client users chat through the backend/admin-selected AI provider only. Provider keys, remote-provider policy, planning rules, and agent connector configuration remain Admin Dashboard responsibilities.
executive_summary.latest_validated_result: Backend npm test passed with 106 tests and 0 failures. Frontend npm run typecheck passed. Frontend npm run build passed with 1545 modules transformed. Playwright smoke test passed with 4 tests and 0 failures.
executive_summary.recommended_next_focus: Proceed to controlled connector-specific setup/testing for Codex, Claude Code, and OpenCode, or add CI smoke-test integration to run Playwright automatically and archive screenshots/reports.

validated_milestones.name: Local MVP hardening
validated_milestones.summary: The Local MVP passed backend tests, frontend typecheck/build, service startup, and Playwright smoke testing in the user's Windows environment.

validated_milestones.name: Client/Admin UX separation
validated_milestones.summary: Client Workspace and Admin Dashboard are visually and functionally distinct. Client UI clearly separates Sources & Files from Knowledge Base and Ask AI. Admin UI is clearly the operator control center.

validated_milestones.name: Provider configuration admin-only
validated_milestones.summary: Client Workspace does not expose AI Provider Configuration. Admin Dashboard Settings expose AI Provider Configuration and remote-provider policy.

validated_milestones.name: Client chat provider hardening
validated_milestones.summary: The public /api/chat route no longer accepts request-body provider override. Client chat follows the admin/backend-selected provider through the configured provider runtime.

validated_milestones.name: Admin Agent Connectors
validated_milestones.summary: Admin Settings now include Admin Agent Connectors for Codex, Claude Code, OpenCode, and other cataloged local agent connectors. Connector visibility is admin-only and validated by Playwright smoke test.

current_architecture_rules: Normal users use Client Workspace only.
Admins/operators use Admin Dashboard for configuration and control.
Client Workspace can chat with AI, but only through the backend/admin-selected active provider.
Client Workspace must not expose provider selection, API keys, remote-provider policy, planning policy, or agent connector configuration.
Admin Dashboard owns provider selection, provider keys, remote-provider policy, planning rules, and Agent Connectors.
Agent Connectors are admin-only and local-machine oriented.
Agent bridge execution is disabled by default and requires explicit backend environment flags.
Browser clients cannot submit arbitrary shell commands.
EverythingAI remains the primary user interface; external tools/providers/connectors are backend/admin-selected engines, not replacement product UIs.
security_and_governance_invariants_prese: Human validation remains separate from quality scoring.
AI validation does not outweigh human validation.
Diagnostics payload backward compatibility remains preserved.
Client chat provider override is blocked by route behavior.
Agent connector execution remains disabled by default.
No file execution behavior was changed.
current_capabilities: Client Workspace with Home, Sources & Files, Knowledge Base, and Ask AI.
Client-side clear distinction between raw indexed files/extracted content and generated Knowledge Base.
Admin Dashboard with Dashboard, Files & Content, Planning, Ask AI, Analytics, and Settings.

Admin AI Provider Configuration with broad provider catalog including Ollama, OpenAI, Anthropic/Claude, OpenRouter, Cerebras, Mistral, Google AI, DeepSeek, Groq, xAI/Grok, Moonshot/Kimi, Together AI, Fireworks, Perplexity, Azure OpenAI, LM Studio, and Custom OpenAI-compatible.
Admin-only Agent Connectors panel covering Codex, Claude Code, OpenCode, Kilo Code, Aider, Continue, and Cline catalog entries.
Agent bridge status refresh, detect, detect-all, and version probe actions in Admin Settings.
Backend agent bridge routes for status, integrations, detection, probes, and chat remain guarded by API token and disabled-by-default execution flags.

Playwright smoke test covering Client/Admin separation, Knowledge Base vs Sources & Files clarity, Ask AI auto-scroll, provider settings admin-only, agent connectors admin-only, and backend reachability.
known_limitations_and_followups: Agent connector commands have not yet been connector-specifically tested against real local Codex, Claude Code, or OpenCode installations.
Agent bridge chat remains disabled unless EVERYTHINGAI_AGENT_BRIDGE_ENABLED=true and EVERYTHINGAI_AGENT_CHAT_ENABLED=true are intentionally set in the backend environment.
CI smoke-test integration is not yet configured. Playwright currently runs locally.
Frontend admin files still include a legacy AdminAppV2 path. SettingsView props were made backward-compatible, but longer-term modular cleanup is recommended.
AnythingLLM remains optional/not configured unless the user intentionally installs and connects it.
OpenDataLoader PDF remains a future optional extraction connector candidate only if it adds clear new extraction functionality beyond the current extractor.

recommended_next_actions.task: Controlled connector-specific setup/testing for Codex, Claude Code, and OpenCode.
recommended_next_actions.validation: Verify command detection, version probe, safety flags, and disabled-by-default behavior before enabling chat. Do not expose connectors to Client Workspace.
Add GitHub Actions workflow or equivalent to run backend tests, frontend typecheck/build, and Playwright smoke tests. Archive smoke screenshots/reports as artifacts.
Reduce legacy/duplicate admin paths carefully. After each extraction/refactor, run frontend typecheck/build and smoke test.

startup_instructions_for_next_agent: Read this handover first before making changes.
Confirm repo is on main and clean with git status.
Do not expose provider/API-key settings or Agent Connectors in Client Workspace.
Do not change trust-score or quality-score calculations.
Do not enable agent bridge execution by default.
After backend changes, run npm test in services/api.
After frontend changes, run npm run typecheck and npm run build in apps/everything-ai-ui.
For UI changes, run npx playwright test smoke/client-admin-smoke.spec.ts --browser=chromium --headed from apps/everything-ai-ui.
